meta.title: Rostyslav Terletskyy — Programmer
meta.description: Portfolio of Rostyslav Terletskyy, a junior programmer working across game development (Unity, Unreal Engine) and web development (TypeScript, Three.js).

hero.description: Junior programmer who likes turning ideas into things you can play or click on. I've built a multiplayer FPS, narrative adventures and a real-time 3D configurator for the browser, working in C++, C#, TypeScript and a handful of other languages. When I'm not coding, I'm probably deep into a shooter or a 3D fighting game.

about.title: About Me
about.lead: I'm a junior programmer who's happiest when there's a hard problem to solve and something on screen to show for it.
about.p1: My work sits between two worlds. On the game side I've built a multiplayer FPS, a survival game, narrative adventures and game-jam entries in Unity and Unreal Engine, mostly in C# and C++. On the web side I've built an interactive 3D configurator with Three.js and TypeScript, along with the website that presents it.
about.p2: What connects the two is how I work. I like understanding what's really happening under the hood, writing code that someone else can pick up without a manual, and staying close to designers and artists so the result feels right. I'm looking for a team where I can keep learning fast and start contributing right away.
